headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a surprise 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other action, the Boston Red Sox took down the Baltimore Orioles 6-3, with Christian Encarnacion-Strand leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Patrick Corbin, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left teres major strain. Jonatan Clase and Samuel Basallo have also been placed on the injured list, while J.T. Ginn, Stephen Kolek, Bobby Witt Jr., Drey Jameson, and Jack Flaherty are out with various injuries.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals taking place. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired RHP Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett, while the Kansas City Royals traded RF Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Yankees Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, securing a shutout victory. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with a single, RBI, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the team at the plate with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Thrilling 5-6 Loss to Braves**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 5-6 in a closely contested matchup, with multiple players making significant impacts on the game. Impact hitters for both teams included Luis Rengifo, Manny Machado, Ty France, Drake Baldwin, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II, and Dominic Smith, while Chris Sale stood out among the pitchers.

top_news.title: **Corbin Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left-hander Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left teres major strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
